symptom: `image imgDone (Image: 'System.Images.Completed')` was 'image collection not found: System.Images' in check and exec although mx check accepts it.
cause: buildImageQualifiedNames lists only the project's image collections; the System module's System.Images and System.WorkflowImages are platform-supplied. Menu icons already exempted System (#980), widget images did not.
fix: meta.SystemImageCollections (measured on 11.12.6: System.Images 26 images, System.WorkflowImages 21) is added to the listing; an image name inside a System collection that the measured list lacks is accepted (other versions hold other images), while an unknown System collection is refused naming the two.
insight: Two reference checks for the same thing (icons vs widget images) had diverged on the System module; when fixing one, grep for the other's exemption (isSystemCollection). For platform data measured on one version, keep the stable part (collection names) strict and the version-dependent part (member names) lenient.
